🐟 Welcome to Abyss!
It’s an open-world underwater survival and exploration game about diving and fishing. Use your tube and harpoon to catch unique fish, some mutated and more valuable than others. Upgrade your gear, face aggressive creatures, and dive deeper!

⚠️ Beta Release!
This game is still under development. If you find any bugs or have suggestions, let us know in our community server!

❓ How to Play?
- Dive Underwater! 
- Catch Fish. 
- Feed the Kraken! 
- Buy Equipment.
- Explore New Biomes, and new content every update!
